description: In the year to September 2026, coconut oil cost 29.5% less across India and coconut 4.0% less, while green coconut cost 8.3% more and sarees 6.0% more (MoSPI's Consumer Price Index, provisional).

Fresh flowers rose 4.9%, bananas 7.5% and clothing overall 4.3%. The map shows MoSPI's division 'Clothing and footwear' by state (India: 3.9%). These are all-India prices for September 2026 against September 2025, not festival-week prices. MoSPI cautions that state-level indices may rest on thin samples of price quotations. September's figures are provisional and will be revised with October's release on 12 November.

Numbers editor (independent) re-read the items and 23 states of each closing map live at MoSPI: no mismatch. Viewer editor: the hook, title and top bar now give the period and 'provisional', so the figures are not read as festival-week prices.
MoSPI lists coconut and green coconut as separate items moving in opposite directions; the card shows both.
